profile.name: Maya Chen
profile.tagline: I build dependable systems, fast internal tools, and product experiences that stay simple as they scale.
profile.about: I am a product-minded software engineer who enjoys the seams between backend architecture, developer experience, and thoughtful interfaces. I like turning ambiguous operational problems into systems that are observable, maintainable, and easy for other teams to build on.
profile.availability: Open to backend, platform, and product engineering opportunities

experience.summary: Built shared platform services for deployment metadata, caching, and observability. Cut repetitive release work by automating dependency discovery and gave product teams clearer operational signals during incidents.
Shipped workflow APIs and internal tooling used by operations teams, with a focus on predictable failure handling, faster debugging, and safer incremental releases.
Created service dashboards, alerts, and automation around a growing payments platform, helping engineers move from reactive debugging to measurable service health.

projects.title: TraceFlow
projects.description: A developer investigation workspace that brings logs, traces, source context, and deployment history into one searchable timeline for faster incident triage.

projects.title: Vector Search Gateway
projects.description: A multi-tenant retrieval service with hybrid search, request-level caching, ingestion jobs, and observable ranking experiments behind a simple API.

projects.title: Schema Studio
projects.description: A collaborative schema editor that turns structured configuration into explorable diagrams, reviewable changes, and shareable developer documentation.

projects.title: QueueScope
projects.description: An operations console for delayed jobs and event pipelines with replay controls, failure grouping, throughput trends, and guardrails for production recovery.

items.description: Automated dependency discovery and validation that replaced a manual release checklist across multiple component types.

items.heading: < 10 min
items.description: Connected service metrics, dashboards, and actionable alerts so engineers could narrow down production issues without reconstructing context by hand.

items.heading: 4 teams
items.description: Designed reusable platform capabilities and documentation that product teams could adopt without owning the underlying infrastructure.
